clue.text: Prepared vindaloo and rice for old Italian

indicators.note: food that is prepared has been chopped and mixed, so the dish and its side are worked into a new order

blocks.note: the curry and its side dish, all fifteen letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A takeaway curry with rice is laid on for an elderly Italian man.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo da Vinci was the Renaissance painter and inventor from Tuscany, so he is an Italian of long ago.

clue.text: I'm at rest after suffering abuse

indicators.note: something suffering is battered out of shape, so the phrase before it is knocked into a new order

blocks.note: the phrase taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Someone says they are finally at peace after enduring cruel treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: To abuse someone is to treat them badly, which is exactly what the verb meaning ill-treat says.

clue.text: Ornamental headdress on display over in Ferrara, Italy

indicators.note: something on display is shown inside the words that follow, sitting there whole
in a down clue, over means turned upside down, so the letters run from bottom to top

blocks.note: the letters spanning the end of the city and the start of the country

explanation.surface: A jewelled crown is being exhibited in an Italian city.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled band or small crown worn on the head as decoration, often at formal occasions.

clue.text: The whole shopping centre supports parking in London thoroughfare

blocks.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
the whole of something is all of it
a mall is a covered shopping centre

explanation.surface: A street plan: a full mall sits on top of a car park on a London road.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, one piece supporting another sits beneath it, so the parking letter goes on top of the rest. Pall Mall is a grand street in St James's, London.
explanation.definitionFit: Pall Mall is a famous street in central London, running from Trafalgar Square towards St James's Palace.

clue.text: Notice group on old boat

blocks.note: R.E.M. is the American rock group
Noah's ark is the ancient vessel

explanation.surface: Pay attention to the band performing aboard an ancient vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'on' puts the band above the boat. 'Group' here is the rock band R.E.M.
explanation.definitionFit: To remark something is to observe or note it, so the verb is a synonym of notice.

clue.text: In favour of getting cash advances

blocks.note: pro means for or in favour of
pounds are British money

explanation.surface: Someone keen on receiving money up front as loans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cash advances' reads as a loan, but 'advances' is a verb here: puts forward an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: To propound a theory is to put it forward for consideration, the sense in which one advances an argument.

clue.text: Rogue deed's strong effect

blocks.note: an imp is a mischievous rascal
an act is a deed

explanation.surface: A scoundrel's action has powerful consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: Impact means a marked influence or force, the forceful consequence something has on a situation.

clue.text: Miss first third of "Born on the Fourth of July", a blockbuster movie

indicators.note: to miss the opening third of the quoted title is to skip its first two of six words

blocks.note: the title's opening third, its first two words, which the instruction drops
first meaning: the American national holiday on that date, left once the opening words go
second meaning: the 1996 alien-invasion film starring Will Smith

explanation.surface: A film buff skips the opening of the Oliver Stone war film, calling it a big hit.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop 'Born on' (two of the title's six words) and 'the Fourth of July' remains: the date of America's national holiday, which is also the name of a 1996 hit film.
explanation.definitionFit: The US celebrates its 1776 break from Britain on that date, and the holiday's name was taken by a hugely successful 1996 science-fiction film.

clue.text: I'm an elite doctor coming up with cure

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the phrase before it is rearranged

blocks.note: the phrase taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A boastful top physician claims to have found a remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like the speaker's job, but it is the verb meaning tamper with.
explanation.definitionFit: To cure a problem is to get rid of it entirely, so the verb meaning remove or wipe out fits.

clue.text: Julius Caesar, for example, dismissed servant

blocks.note: RO is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for run out, a way a batter is dismissed
a man is a manservant

explanation.surface: Caesar has sacked a member of his household staff.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batter who is run out is out, i.e. dismissed, and scorecards record it as RO.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius Caesar was a citizen of ancient Rome, so he is one instance of a Roman.

clue.text: An ultra-innovative note

indicators.note: an innovative version is a new arrangement, so the letters before it are reordered

blocks.note: the two words taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: A very inventive memo or musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, a natural is a note that is neither sharp nor flat, marked with its own sign.

clue.text: Quiet parrot consuming vegetables

indicators.note: something consuming another takes it inside itself, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: to parrot or ape is to copy
peas are green vegetables

explanation.surface: A silent parrot is eating its greens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quiet' looks like an adjective for the bird, but it is a verb, to calm. 'Parrot' is also a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: To appease someone is to pacify or calm them, which is the verb sense of quiet.

clue.text: Bitterly regrets regularly dropping trousers

indicators.note: dropping at regular intervals means losing every other letter of the word that follows

blocks.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters

explanation.surface: Someone deeply sorry that their trousers keep falling down.
explanation.definitionFit: To rue something is to feel sorrow or remorse over it, so it is a synonym for bitter regret.

clue.text: Ella struck Dizzy as uninspired

indicators.note: a dizzy head is spinning, so the letters before it are spun into a new order

blocks.note: the two words taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: Ella Fitzgerald thought Dizzy Gillespie's playing was dull.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pairs two jazz greats, Ella Fitzgerald and Dizzy Gillespie, so 'Dizzy' reads as a name rather than an instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacklustre means dull and lacking energy or brilliance, a near synonym of uninspired.

clue.text: Discover facial hair may cause distress

blocks.note: to hear news is to find it out
tache is British slang for moustache

explanation.surface: Finding a moustache on your face could be upsetting.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartache is emotional anguish or grief, a kind of mental suffering the same as distress.

clue.text: Reveals measure to achieve more sales

blocks.note: to out something is to expose it
an ell is an old unit of length

explanation.surface: A firm discloses a sales metric showing it is beating its target.
explanation.definitionFit: To outsell a rival product is to be bought in greater numbers than it, so achieving higher sales figures.

clue.text: Elderly male has to support spinster

blocks.note: elderly means old
M is the standard abbreviation for male
aid is help or support

explanation.surface: An aged man is obliged to look after an unmarried woman.
explanation.definitionFit: An old maid is a dated, unkind term for a woman who has never married, the same as a spinster.

clue.text: Order one to leave weapons

indicators.note: for something to leave is for it to go out of the word, which then lacks it

blocks.note: an ordinance is an official decree or order
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A commander tells a soldier to abandon the guns.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the I from the word for a decree and what remains is the military term for artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordnance is military supplies, especially artillery and munitions, so it covers weapons collectively.

clue.text: For example JFK and Charles de Gaulle used them a lot

definitions.text: For example JFK and Charles de Gaulle used them a lot

blocks.clueFragment: For example JFK and Charles de Gaulle used them a lot
blocks.note: surface reading: two statesmen, a US president and a French president, who often relied on something
setter's reading: these are the names of the big terminals at New York and Paris, places travellers pass through constantly

explanation.walkthrough: The names read as two presidents, but they are also the names of New York's and Paris's main air hubs, and huge numbers of travellers use those.
explanation.definitionFit: John F. Kennedy International and Charles de Gaulle are the major international air terminals serving New York and Paris respectively.

clue.text: Sweet child having guardian locked up later

indicators.note: something locked up is shut inside, so one piece sits within the other

blocks.note: afters is British informal for dessert
a ward is a minor under the care of a guardian

explanation.surface: A lovely child with a guardian has been imprisoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet' looks like an adjective for the child, but it is a noun: afters, the British word for pudding or dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Afterwards is an adverb meaning at a subsequent time, which is what later means.

clue.text: Sample round from toaster

indicators.note: taking something from a word means removing it, leaving the rest behind

blocks.note: O is round in shape
taken as written

explanation.surface: Try a slice of bread popped from the toaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round' looks like a round of toast, but it stands for the letter O, removed from the kitchen appliance.
explanation.definitionFit: A taster is a small portion offered to let someone try something, the noun sense of a sample.

clue.text: Removal of dissident group's head leads to fighting

indicators.note: removal means a part is taken away, here the part named after the possessive
the head is the very top, so in a down word it is the opening letter that goes

blocks.note: a faction is a breakaway group within a party

explanation.surface: Ousting the rebels' leader sparks combat.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers who see action are in combat, so the noun carries the military sense of fighting.

clue.text: Wandering around Ireland

indicators.note: the word before goes around the answer, holding it inside its own letters

blocks.note: the fifth to eighth letters of the word

explanation.surface: Touring the Irish countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wandering around' reads as rambling about, but the first word literally surrounds the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Erin is the old poetic name for Ireland, from the Irish Éirinn, familiar from the slogan Erin go bragh.

clue.text: Hop bud used in cooking

blocks.note: first meaning: a playful skipping leap
second meaning: the pickled flower bud of a Mediterranean shrub

explanation.surface: Hops and buds both sound like brewing or kitchen ingredients.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hop' tempts you towards brewing, since hops are a plant, but it is the verb or noun for a jump.
explanation.definitionFit: A caper is a frisky jump, and capers are the pickled flower buds sprinkled on fish and in sauces.

clue.text: Mo's ready straight away

blocks.note: first meaning: a moment, as in 'half a mo'
second meaning: prepared at once, like the coffee

explanation.surface: Someone called Mo is prepared immediately.
explanation.walkthrough: Mo looks like a person's name, but it is British slang for a moment, as in 'wait a mo'.
explanation.definitionFit: An instant is a very brief moment, and instant food or drink is ready to consume with no delay.

clue.text: Mission of French? To be fashionable!

blocks.note: the Alamo was a Spanish mission in Texas
de is French for of

explanation.surface: A French envoy's assignment is to look stylish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mission' reads as a task, but it is the Alamo, the famous mission-turned-fort in San Antonio.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means 'in the fashion', so to be in this state is to be stylish and up to date.

clue.text: Reportedly arrest Central European

indicators.note: reportedly means as people say it, so the word is matched by how it is spoken

blocks.note: to check something is to halt or arrest it

explanation.surface: News reports say a man from central Europe has been detained.
explanation.definitionFit: A Czech is a native of the Czech Republic, a country in the centre of Europe.

clue.text: Her co-star played in band

indicators.note: something played with is moved about, so the words before it are rearranged

blocks.note: the words taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: An actress's fellow lead performed in a musical group.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra is a large ensemble of musicians, and band is a general word for such a group of players.
